newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish police investigate Austrian girl murder.
newsitem.headline: Turkish police investigate Austrian girl murder.

text.p: A 14-year-old Austrian girl was found murdered at a popular resort in southwest Turkey, Anatolian news agency said on Wednesday.
It said the girl, named as Sonya Kogler, was found dead with severe wounds to the head in her room at a holiday village near the town of Bodrum in the early hours of Wednesday.
Turkish police held the girl's mother, uncle and mother's boyfriend for questioning, the agency said.
It said the girl had returned to her room alone on Tuesday evening after celebrating her birthday with the three.
